greeting.late: Still up? A quick recap is plenty. Sleep is part of preparing too.

countdown.today: Today, 2:00 PM — you’ve prepared for this.

checklist.allDone: Nice work, you finished today’s revision!
checklist.allDoneSub: Rest well — sleep helps it stick.
checklist.empty: Nothing planned yet. Want to add one topic to start with?

milestones.25: A quarter of the way there. Good start.
milestones.50: Halfway there. The second half feels easier from here.
milestones.75: Three-quarters done. You’re closer than you think.
milestones.100: Everything revised. Now rest and let it settle.

questions.lt4: Answer from memory first, then peek.
questions.gte4: Halfway! Each one makes the next easier.
questions.all: All revised. Now rest and let it settle.

calendar.empty: Nothing planned. A free day is fine too.

gentle.missed: Missed yesterday’s plan? No problem. We’ve moved it to today.
gentle.notStarted: Heads-up: {subject} hasn’t been started yet. Want to begin with one small topic?
gentle.tip: A 25-minute session is enough to make progress. Try recalling answers before you peek.

admitCard.idleSub: We’ll read your exam timetable and build a calm study plan around it.
admitCard.privacy: We only read subjects, dates and times. You confirm everything, and you can delete the file anytime.

plan.title: Your plan is ready
plan.sub: Built around your three exams, with lighter days right before each one.

assistant.hello: Hi! I can plan your week, quiz you, or explain anything from your notes. What would help right now?
assistant.notConnected: Offline assistant · answers from your own plan
